meta.name: hiring
meta.description: Hiring signal tracking for B2B outbound. Use when the user asks about hiring signals, job posting intent, new roles, missing roles, leaving employees, skills-targeting, role-targeting, headcount growth, or team expansion signals. Do NOT use for individual job changes (use job-changes skill) or general company events (use company-events skill).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪企业招聘信号，赋能B2B外呼
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果通过招聘信号寻找潜在客户
copy.tagline_en: Track hiring signals to boost B2B outbound.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify prospects via hiring signals.

howto.what: Claude 会检测公司的招聘信号，包括新增职位、缺失角色、员工离职等，并生成针对性的外联话术模板。
howto.when: 当你询问关于招聘信号、职位发布、新角色、缺失角色、离职员工等话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我找最近在招销售代表的公司。
say.note: Claude 会搜索职位并生成外联文案。
Claude 会筛选缺失角色的公司并提供话术。

say.text: 看看我目标客户里谁刚离职了。
say.note: Claude 会检测离职信号并建议1-2周内联系。

howto.what_en: Claude detects hiring signals such as new roles, missing roles, and departing employees, then generates outreach templates based on the signal type.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask about hiring signals, job postings, new roles, missing roles, leaving employees, skills-targeting, role-targeting, headcount growth, or team expansion.

say_en.note: Claude searches job boards and drafts outreach.

say_en.text: Which companies lack a RevOps role?
say_en.note: Claude identifies missing roles and provides a template.

say_en.text: Who recently left my target accounts?
say_en.note: Claude detects departures and suggests contacting within 1-2 weeks.
